result.text:
MASTER PARTICIPATING FACILITY AGREEMENT
This Master Participating Facility Agreement is made on the 24th day of April, 2021 between Cobalt Mutual
Health and Westfield Cardiology Associates.

1. DEFINITIONS
"Effective Date" means April 24, 2021. "Clean Claim" means a claim that can be processed without
obtaining additional information from the Provider. "Medicare Fee Schedule" means the applicable CMS fee
schedule in effect on the date of service. "Plan" means Cobalt Mutual Health. "Facility" means Westfield
Cardiology Associates.

2. TERM
2.1 The term of this Agreement begins on the Effective Date and ends on 23 Apr 2026, unless sooner
terminated.
2.2 Upon expiration of the term, this Agreement shall renew automatically for successive twelve (12) month
terms unless terminated in accordance with Section 2.3.
2.3 Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause by giving 180 days written notice.

3. COMPENSATION
3.1 Acute inpatient services shall be reimbursed at a per diem of $3,375.
3.2 General outpatient services shall be reimbursed at 145% of the Medicare Fee Schedule.

4. CLAIMS
4.1 The Plan shall pay each Clean Claim within 20 days of receipt. 4.2 The Facility shall submit claims
within 365 days of the date of service.

5. CREDENTIALING
5.1 The Plan shall complete credentialing within 90 days of a complete application.

6. GENERAL
6.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas.
Confidentiality. Each party shall keep the financial terms of this Agreement confidential and shall disclose
them only as required by law.
Insurance. Provider shall maintain professional liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000 per
occurrence.
Records. Each party shall retain records relating to services for 10 years following the date of service.
Disputes. The parties shall attempt in good faith to resolve any dispute through informal negotiation for up
to 30 days before pursuing other remedies.

AMENDMENT NO. 1
Effective April 24, 2022, the parties amend Sections 3.1 and 3.2 of the Agreement as set out below. All other
terms remain unchanged.
Section 3.1 is deleted and replaced with: "Acute inpatient services shall be reimbursed at a per diem of
$3,575."
Section 3.2 is deleted and replaced with: "General outpatient services shall be reimbursed at 155% of the
Medicare Fee Schedule."
